sources.entry: Readeck - Save the precious readable content of web pages you like and want to keep forever. See it as a bookmark manager and a read later tool. (Source Code, Clients) AGPL-3.0 Go/Docker

summary.name: Readeck
summary.one_liner: Readeck is a self-hostable read-later app and bookmark manager that saves web articles, pictures, and videos so you can read or revisit them later.
use_cases: build reading collections for a trip
summary.what_it_does: Readeck saves web content such as articles, long reads, pictures, and videos as bookmarks. You can archive items, mark favorites, add labels, and search your saved content or build dynamic collections. It lets you highlight text and browse highlights across all content. For video links it retrieves the transcript when available so it can be read like an article. Articles and collections can be exported as a single ebook, with a standard catalog for supported e-readers. A browser extension saves pages while browsing, including content behind logins that Readeck itself cannot access.
notable: Exports articles and collections as ebooks for e-readers
Browser extension can save content Readeck cannot access itself
caveats: Platform support beyond web, Docker and Go is not stated on the page
Hosting and setup details are not given on the page
